ineligibleFixtureFamilies.reason: Direct sampled texture plus sampler LOD facts, direct storage-image load/store facts with read, write, read_write, and explicit r32f/r32i/r32ui formats, one direct storage-image atomic operation-family fixture, one fixed storage-buffer descriptor-array catalog fixture, one fixed sampled texture plus sampler descriptor-array catalog fixture, one literal-index fixed storage-image descriptor-array catalog fixture, and one nonuniform storage-image descriptor-array marker catalog fixture are admitted; runtime descriptor arrays, broad dynamic storage-image indexing beyond cataloged literal/nonuniform-marker facts, access-qualified storage-image array indexing or lowering, nonuniform descriptor-array storage-image atomics, compare helpers, manual texture intrinsics, real MLIR lowering, and backend descriptor-indexing policy remain blocked.

Only fixed literal storage-buffer, sampled texture/sampler, and storage-image descriptor-array indices plus one nonuniform storage-image descriptor-array marker fixture are report-only descriptor-array evidence; the access-qualified fixture records a readonly fixed-array storage-image declaration as source/resource metadata only. Runtime descriptor arrays, dynamic indexes beyond cataloged literal/nonuniform-marker facts, folded-symbolic indexes outside cataloged literal facts, nonuniform descriptor-array storage-image atomics, real MLIR lowering, and backend descriptor-indexing policy remain blocked.
Production backend policy, package schemas, and target legalization remain outside Milestone 7 experiment scope.
